title: StoryAlt
author: SKV Games
summary: The game developer's 2021 example mod, in the StoryAlt format that game 1.6.12 no longer loads.

files.name: Quest150.json
files.text:
{
  "settings": {
    "QuestName": "Following Marcus",
    "QuestDescription": "Marcus has gone to ground, and we need him before anyone else finds him.",
    "ID": 9001,
    "StationName": "Thunder Station",
    "Lang": "en",
    "isRandomStationQuest": false,
    "isRandomSpaceQuest": false,
    "RandomQuestX": 0,
    "RandomQuestY": 0,
    "RandomQuestRadius": 0,
    "RandomSpaceQuestChance": 0.0,
    "CharName": "Edmond Anger",
    "CharImage": "Edmond Anger",
    "MinKarma": -101,
    "MaxKarma": 101,
    "Faction": "none",
    "FactionMinRep": 0,
    "RandomSpaceQuestTrigger": null,
    "RequestedQuestIDCompleted": null,
    "Reward": 0,
    "KarmaReward": 0
  },
  "BarRumors": [
    {
      "text": "Somebody at Manson Orbital is paying well for couriers who don't ask what they carry.",
      "type": "global"
    }
  ],
  "questParts": [
    {
      "name": "Briefing",
      "TODO": "Decide where to look for Marcus first.",
      "questID": 1,
      "isCheckPoint": true,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Edmond Anger",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "The exact location of our man is unknown.",
          "character": "Edmond Anger",
          "options": ""
        },
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "But we don't have time to search everywhere.",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        },
        {
          "Name": "Edmond Anger",
          "showTimeSec": 99999999,
          "text": "Then you'll have to choose where to fly first.",
          "character": "Edmond Anger",
          "options": "2=Head straight for Wolf 359;10=Check Ross 720 first;"
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_DIALOG_COMPLETE",
      "dialogTextRepeat": null,
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 999999999
    },
    {
      "name": "Detour to Ross 720",
      "TODO": "Fly to Ross 720 and look for any sign of Marcus.",
      "questID": 10,
      "isCheckPoint": true,
      "dialogText": [],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_WARP_END_SYSTEM_Ross 720",
      "dialogTextRepeat": null,
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 999999999
    },
    {
      "name": "Nothing at Ross 720",
      "TODO": "Marcus isn't at Ross 720. Head for Wolf 359.",
      "questID": 11,
      "isCheckPoint": false,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 99999999,
          "text": "Nothing here. He never came this way.",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": "2=Then it's Wolf 359;"
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_DIALOG_COMPLETE",
      "dialogTextRepeat": null,
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 999999999
    },
    {
      "name": "Fly to Wolf 359",
      "TODO": "Fly to the Wolf 359 system.",
      "questID": 2,
      "isCheckPoint": true,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "We need to get to the Wolf 359 system.",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_WARP_END_SYSTEM_Wolf 359",
      "dialogTextRepeat": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "We need to get to the Wolf 359 system.",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 240
    },
    {
      "name": "Ambush",
      "TODO": "Destroy the bounty hunter who followed you.",
      "questID": 3,
      "isCheckPoint": false,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "We were followed. We have to take out this bounty hunter.",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_SHIP_DESTROYED_Hunter",
      "dialogTextRepeat": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "Hurry!",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 240,
      "shipSpawn": [
        {
          "Name": "Hunter",
          "shipModel": "atom",
          "shipLevel": "Master",
          "shipBehavior": "Enemy",
          "autoLVL": false,
          "spawnX": 0,
          "spawnY": 0,
          "distanceFromPlayer": 300
        }
      ],
      "shipControl": [
        {
          "ShipName": "Hunter",
          "SetTarget": "player",
          "Attack": true,
          "Destroy": false,
          "shipBehavior": "Enemy"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "Dock at Manson Orbital",
      "TODO": "Dock at Manson Orbital in Wolf 359.",
      "questID": 4,
      "isCheckPoint": true,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "Looks like our target is Manson Orbital.",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_CLICK_STATION_Manson Orbital",
      "dialogTextRepeat": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "No time to waste, get to Manson Orbital!",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 240
    },
    {
      "name": "Marcus's job",
      "TODO": "Accept Marcus's job at Manson Orbital.",
      "questID": 5,
      "isCheckPoint": false,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Marcus",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "So you found me after all! Fine, I have work for you. I'll tell you everything once it's done.",
          "character": "Marcus",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "CLICK_ACCEPT_STORY_MISSION",
      "dialogTextRepeat": null,
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 999999999,
      "task_on_station": {
        "Type": "TransferGoods",
        "Level": "Low",
        "HomeStation": "Manson Orbital",
        "TargetSystem": "Sirius",
        "TargetStation": "Cooper City",
        "TargetShipType": "Ion",
        "TargetShipName": "",
        "TargetShipHull": 1,
        "TargetGoods": "Narcotics",
        "TargetGoodsCount": 2,
        "Reward": 100000,
        "Reputation": 2,
        "Story": true
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "Deliver the cargo",
      "TODO": "Deliver the cargo to Cooper City in Sirius and collect the reward.",
      "questID": 6,
      "isCheckPoint": true,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Marcus",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "Excellent, I knew you wouldn't say no. Now go!",
          "character": "Marcus",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "GET_STORY_REWARD",
      "dialogTextRepeat": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "No time, we have to deliver the cargo!",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 240
    },
    {
      "name": "Goodbye",
      "TODO": "We did it.",
      "questID": 7,
      "isCheckPoint": false,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 99999999,
          "text": "We did it! Time to say goodbye.",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": "-1=OK, bye!;"
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_DIALOG_COMPLETE",
      "dialogTextRepeat": null,
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 999999999
    }
  ]
}

files.name: Quest151.json
files.text:
{
  "settings": {
    "QuestName": "По следу Маркуса",
    "QuestDescription": "Маркус залёг на дно, и нам нужно найти его раньше остальных.",
    "ID": 9001,
    "StationName": "Thunder Station",
    "Lang": "ru",
    "isRandomStationQuest": false,
    "isRandomSpaceQuest": false,
    "RandomQuestX": 0,
    "RandomQuestY": 0,
    "RandomQuestRadius": 0,
    "RandomSpaceQuestChance": 0.0,
    "CharName": "Edmond Anger",
    "CharImage": "Edmond Anger",
    "MinKarma": -101,
    "MaxKarma": 101,
    "Faction": "none",
    "FactionMinRep": 0,
    "RandomSpaceQuestTrigger": null,
    "RequestedQuestIDCompleted": null,
    "Reward": 0,
    "KarmaReward": 0
  },
  "BarRumors": [
    {
      "text": "Говорят, на Manson Orbital хорошо платят курьерам, которые не спрашивают, что везут.",
      "type": "global"
    }
  ],
  "questParts": [
    {
      "name": "Briefing",
      "TODO": "Решить, где сначала искать Маркуса.",
      "questID": 1,
      "isCheckPoint": true,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Edmond Anger",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "Точное местонахождение объекта неизвестно.",
          "character": "Edmond Anger",
          "options": ""
        },
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "Но у нас нет времени на поиски.",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        },
        {
          "Name": "Edmond Anger",
          "showTimeSec": 99999999,
          "text": "Тогда вам нужно будет выбрать, куда лететь в первую очередь.",
          "character": "Edmond Anger",
          "options": "2=Летим к Wolf 359;10=Сначала проверим Ross 720;"
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_DIALOG_COMPLETE",
      "dialogTextRepeat": null,
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 999999999
    },
    {
      "name": "Detour to Ross 720",
      "TODO": "Лететь в Ross 720 и искать следы Маркуса.",
      "questID": 10,
      "isCheckPoint": true,
      "dialogText": [],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_WARP_END_SYSTEM_Ross 720",
      "dialogTextRepeat": null,
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 999999999
    },
    {
      "name": "Nothing at Ross 720",
      "TODO": "В Ross 720 Маркуса нет. Летим к Wolf 359.",
      "questID": 11,
      "isCheckPoint": false,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 99999999,
          "text": "Здесь ничего. Он не проходил этим путём.",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": "2=Тогда летим к Wolf 359;"
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_DIALOG_COMPLETE",
      "dialogTextRepeat": null,
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 999999999
    },
    {
      "name": "Fly to Wolf 359",
      "TODO": "Лететь в систему Wolf 359.",
      "questID": 2,
      "isCheckPoint": true,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "Нам нужно попасть в систему Wolf 359.",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_WARP_END_SYSTEM_Wolf 359",
      "dialogTextRepeat": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "Нам нужно попасть в систему Wolf 359.",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 240
    },
    {
      "name": "Ambush",
      "TODO": "Уничтожить охотника за головами, который шёл за нами.",
      "questID": 3,
      "isCheckPoint": false,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "За нами следили. Нам нужно уничтожить этого охотника за головами.",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_SHIP_DESTROYED_Hunter",
      "dialogTextRepeat": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "Нам нужно поспешить!",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 240,
      "shipSpawn": [
        {
          "Name": "Hunter",
          "shipModel": "atom",
          "shipLevel": "Master",
          "shipBehavior": "Enemy",
          "autoLVL": false,
          "spawnX": 0,
          "spawnY": 0,
          "distanceFromPlayer": 300
        }
      ],
      "shipControl": [
        {
          "ShipName": "Hunter",
          "SetTarget": "player",
          "Attack": true,
          "Destroy": false,
          "shipBehavior": "Enemy"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "Dock at Manson Orbital",
      "TODO": "Пристыковаться к Manson Orbital в системе Wolf 359.",
      "questID": 4,
      "isCheckPoint": true,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "Похоже, что наша цель - это станция Manson Orbital.",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_CLICK_STATION_Manson Orbital",
      "dialogTextRepeat": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "Нельзя медлить, летим на станцию Manson Orbital!",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 240
    },
    {
      "name": "Marcus's job",
      "TODO": "Принять задание Маркуса на Manson Orbital.",
      "questID": 5,
      "isCheckPoint": false,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Marcus",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "Вы всё-таки нашли меня! Хорошо, тогда для вас есть работа. Я вам расскажу всё после выполнения задания!",
          "character": "Marcus",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "CLICK_ACCEPT_STORY_MISSION",
      "dialogTextRepeat": null,
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 999999999,
      "task_on_station": {
        "Type": "TransferGoods",
        "Level": "Low",
        "HomeStation": "Manson Orbital",
        "TargetSystem": "Sirius",
        "TargetStation": "Cooper City",
        "TargetShipType": "Ion",
        "TargetShipName": "",
        "TargetShipHull": 1,
        "TargetGoods": "Narcotics",
        "TargetGoodsCount": 2,
        "Reward": 100000,
        "Reputation": 2,
        "Story": true
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "Deliver the cargo",
      "TODO": "Доставить груз в Cooper City в системе Sirius и получить награду.",
      "questID": 6,
      "isCheckPoint": true,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Marcus",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "Отлично, я знал, что вы не откажетесь! А теперь прочь!",
          "character": "Marcus",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "GET_STORY_REWARD",
      "dialogTextRepeat": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 6,
          "text": "У нас нет времени, нужно доставить груз!",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": ""
        }
      ],
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 240
    },
    {
      "name": "Goodbye",
      "TODO": "Мы справились.",
      "questID": 7,
      "isCheckPoint": false,
      "dialogText": [
        {
          "Name": "Eva",
          "showTimeSec": 99999999,
          "text": "Мы справились! Время прощаться!",
          "character": "Eva",
          "options": "-1=Ок, пока!;"
        }
      ],
      "completeAction": "ACTION_DIALOG_COMPLETE",
      "dialogTextRepeat": null,
      "repeatTextTimeSec": 999999999
    }
  ]
}
